works.author: Permadi Satria Dewanto for Plainthing Studio
works.comment: 销售营销管理 SaaS 落地页 Marketer：紫底上笔记本实拍图，仪表盘里 $13,963 总销售额、83% 成本节省、橙色 Sales Rating 卡片一并入镜；大标题“Revolutionize Approach”配火箭 emoji，SaaS 落地页用“真实产品截图 + 关键数字”一次讲清价值，比纯口号可信。
works.comment_en: Marketer sales and marketing SaaS landing page: a laptop mockup on a purple backdrop shows the live dashboard — $13,963 in total product sales, 83% cost saved, an orange Sales Rating card — under the headline "Revolutionize Approach"; real product screenshots plus hard numbers sell the value instead of slogans.
works.title: Marketer Saas - Sales & Marketing Management Website Animation

works.author: BayFi UI/UX® for BayFi®
works.comment: AI 智能戒指仪表盘 Orra：黑底衬金色戒指实拍渲染，大标题“Rested enough for a harder day.”，就绪度 86、静息心率 54、睡眠 7h 42m、心率变异性 64 一屏排开；右侧 Ask Orra 对话入口把“数据 + AI 解读”收进同一屏，健康硬件仪表盘的范本。
works.comment_en: Orra AI smart ring dashboard: a black layout with a gold ring render and the headline "Rested enough for a harder day." — readiness 86, resting heart rate 54, 7h 42m of sleep and HRV 64 in one view; an Ask Orra panel beside the charts pairs raw metrics with AI interpretation, a template for health-hardware dashboards.
works.title: Orra - AI Smart Ring Dashboard

works.author: NexUX Product for Nexux Lab
works.comment: AI 牙科诊所管理仪表盘 Dentora：中央一颗 3D 种植牙渲染图镇场，左侧今日患者排班、右侧 AI 牙科助手对话、底部口腔健康评分 86 与 5 颗蛀牙统计；医疗后台用“大幅解剖图 + 患者列表 + AI 助手”三栏，把专业感与效率一次给全。
works.comment_en: Dentora AI dental clinic dashboard: a 3D implant render anchors the center, today's patient schedule on the left, an AI dental assistant chat on the right, and an oral health score of 86 with 5 cavities found below — a three-column clinical workspace that pairs anatomical visuals with scheduling and AI triage.
works.title: AI Dental Clinic Management Dashboard

works.author: Imran Jakir
works.comment: 普拉提健身 App：三屏并列——左屏按身体部位选训练重点（Toned Arms、Flat belly），中屏 Day 1 挑战卡“7 个动作、6 分钟”，右屏课程详情（初级、50.4 kcal、6 分钟）；从选目标到开练三步走完，健身 App 的上手路径做得极顺。
works.comment_en: Pilates fitness app: three screens walk the user from picking a focus area (Toned Arms, Flat belly) to a Day 1 challenge card (7 exercises, 6 minutes) to a class detail (Beginner, 50.4 kcal, 6 min) — a three-step path from goal to workout that makes onboarding feel effortless.
works.title: Fitness Tracking & Pilates Workout Mobile App UIUX Design

works.author: Aminur Rahman
works.comment: 宠物用品 Shopify 电商 BOOP：亮橙底配“GOOD PETS. GREAT DAYS.”超大标题，比格犬照片嵌进黄色拱形、旁边“hi, human!”对话气泡；Dogs / Cats / Treats / Toys / Grooming 导航加两款产品包入镜，宠物电商用“高饱和撞色 + 拟人化文案”一次拉满亲和力。
works.comment_en: BOOP pet-supplies Shopify store: a loud orange page with the giant headline "GOOD PETS. GREAT DAYS.", a beagle photo inside a yellow arch and a "hi, human!" speech bubble; Dogs, Cats, Treats, Toys and Grooming nav plus two product packs — saturated color and personified copy make pet ecommerce instantly warm.
works.title: Playful Pet Supplies | Shopify eCommerce Website Design

works.author: Samuel Oktavianus
works.comment: 生物技术实验室自动化官网 ordivalabs：蓝图风等距线稿画出机械臂、样本瓶与夹持器，粉色标签点出 Module B / Gripper / Sample Vials，大标题“From Sample To Possibility.”；硬核工业设备用“工程图纸 + 四步流程”讲故事，B2B 官网的克制高级感范本。
works.comment_en: ordivalabs biotech lab automation site: a blueprint-style isometric line drawing of the robotic arm, sample vials and gripper, pink labels marking Module B, Gripper and Sample Vials under the headline "From Sample To Possibility." — engineering-drawing aesthetics plus a four-step flow give hard industrial tech a restrained, premium B2B voice.
works.title: ordivalabs: Precision Biotech Laboratory Automation - Website UI

works.author: Awe Mobile App for Awe Design Studio
works.comment: AI 聊天机器人 App Intella Ai：三屏并列——左侧对话实录、中间蓝色玻璃球配“What can I help you with today?”、右侧语音输入“I'm listening, go ahead.”；Brainstorm ideas / Code / Analyze / Create image 五枚快捷入口排在输入框上，AI 聊天 App 用“玻璃拟态球体 + 语音优先”做出辨识度。
works.comment_en: Intella Ai chatbot app: three screens — a chat transcript, a blue glass orb asking "What can I help you with today?", and a voice-first "I'm listening, go ahead." — with Brainstorm ideas, Code, Analyze, Create image and Ask me anything chips above the input; a glassmorphic orb and voice-first flow give the AI chat app its identity.
works.title: Intella Ai - Chatbot App Design

works.author: SlabPixel Designer for SlabPixel
works.comment: AI SaaS 落地页 Nexus：柔和天空渐变底上大标题“Technical buyers trust products, not promises.”，直戳技术买家痛点；下方直接贴出 Agent IDE 实机截图（GPT-2、Opus 4.2、Review status），加 4.5/5（1400 用户）评分背书；面向工程师卖产品的落地页，用“一句反承诺口号 + 真实界面”建立信任。
works.comment_en: Nexus AI SaaS landing page: a soft sky gradient carries the headline "Technical buyers trust products, not promises." — a slogan aimed squarely at technical buyers — above a real agent IDE screenshot (GPT-2, Opus 4.2, review status) and a 4.5/5 rating from 1,400 users; proof over promises, shown not told.
works.title: Nexus — AI SaaS & Automation Landing Page
